context: Two teens recap a school sports-festival highlight
purpose: Teach: 堪能/成熟/学級/到来/繰り広げ/下さる/そうなると/まわっ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日の体育祭、めっちゃやばかったよね！三年生の応援合戦が繰り広げられてた時、鳥肌立ったわ。
lines.en: Yesterday's sports festival was so insane! When the third-years' cheer battle was unfolding, I got chills.
lines.style: Bright, animated, fast-paced teenage girl enthusiasm with casual slang

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる！うちの学級、リレーで一位取れてさ、先生がご褒美くれるらしいよ。
lines.en: Right! Our class won the relay, and apparently the teacher's gonna give us a reward.
lines.style: Casual, slightly hyped teenage boy tone with rising excitement

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: マジで？じゃあ勝利を堪能できんじゃん、いいなー。うちのクラス、トラック必死にまわってたのに四位だったし…
lines.en: Seriously? Then you get to fully savor the win, lucky. Our class ran around the track like crazy and still came fourth.
lines.style: Mock-jealous, playful pouting with quick comedic timing and casual whining

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: でもサクラの走り、フォームめっちゃきれいだったよ。中学の時より動きが成熟したっていうか、全然速くなってた。
lines.en: But your running form was really clean. Your movement's matured or something — you've gotten way faster than in middle school.
lines.style: Sincere, slightly shy compliment from teenage boy, searching for the right word

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー嬉しい、ありがと。そうなると来年こそ優勝のチャンス到来かもね、本気で狙っちゃおっかな。
lines.en: Aww, thanks, that makes me happy. In that case, next year might be our championship chance — maybe I'll really go for it.
lines.style: Warm, giggly, then suddenly determined teenage girl shifting energy

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: だな。あの紙吹雪パーって舞ってた感じ、もう一回見たいわ。来年は絶対一位狙おうぜ。
lines.en: Yeah. I want to see that confetti fluttering down like that one more time. Let's definitely aim for first place next year.
lines.style: Determined, motivational teenage boy with friendly grin and casual ending

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そういえば写真係の先輩、こういう時いつも部活のサイトに上げて下さるよね。後で一緒に見ようよ！
lines.en: Oh yeah, the photo-team senpai already kindly uploaded them to the club site. Let's look at them together later!
lines.style: Excited invitation, phone-tapping energy, bubbly teenage girl using polite form for senpai

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね、放課後な。明日の登校、筋肉痛できついかもだけど絶対行くわ。
lines.en: Sounds good, after school then. Tomorrow's walk to school might be rough with sore muscles, but I'll definitely come.
lines.style: Easygoing, slightly groaning teenage boy with friendly closing tone
